openQuestions.question: Is PMR-025 a new design-snapshot/artifact bundle, or an extension of the existing ExecutionPlanBundle?
Does import produce DesignSnapshot/bindings only, or does it create/update execution plans?

openQuestions.question: What exactly is `namespace`? It is not aligned yet with the existing `sourceNamespace` field.
What are the typed reference kinds and scope rules?

additionalOpenQuestion.question: How can an export surface labeled GET and READ_ONLY satisfy the approved direction to store exported bytes as an immutable ArtifactRevision?

Persistence requires a generation/write lifecycle absent from a read-only retrieval label.
alternativesForDecision: GET retrieves an already-created immutable ArtifactRevision; the operation that created and persisted it is defined separately.

An asynchronous export job creates and persists the revision, then a later scoped GET retrieves the result.
The GET itself generates and persists a new revision, which has write side effects and would require review/reclassification of the READ_ONLY surface.
